summary: Ondas Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 3.02 and 8.01) to report the filing of a prospectus supplement covering the resale of 2,583 shares of common stock by certain stockholders. These shares were issued as consideration in the prior acquisition of World View Enterprises Inc. on April 1, 2026. The filing is a routine, non-discretionary securities registration matter, not a special situation event. It simply registers shares for resale under an existing effective shelf registration statement. No price, premium, board recommendation, or structural mechanics are mentioned. There is no event-driven catalyst or special situation beyond the ministerial filing. What to watch: none; this is purely procedural.
